# Overview
`gitboard` serves as a local code-change board for GitLab and GitHub, providing a structured view of repository activity. This grounding map outlines the system's functional boundaries and component roles.
## Bounded Contexts and Objectives
The system is organized into specialized slices, each fulfilling a distinct role within the `gitboard` ecosystem:
`board`: Manages the core JSON data structures utilized by the dashboard and supporting components.
`localgit`: Facilitates local Git operations and provides metadata enrichment for local repositories.
`remotegit`: Handles interactions with remote Git services.
`llm`: Provides an OpenAI-compatible chat completions client, adapting external API responses for system use.
`cliexec`: A utility slice responsible for executing external processes via `os/exec`.
`dashboard`: Aggregates various data views for user visualization and interaction.
## Typology Mapping
Components are categorized via the Typology catalog to maintain clear separation of concerns, ensuring that orchestration layers consume data from well-defined utility slices rather than direct implementation details.
